sources.note: Gzipped tar of the LaTeX source; main file SPARC.tex, SHA-256 51504da75138e28c5d31ed875457e64d34d7d3edaf035b3f3319daa0f2b127c5. Its gzip header carries a 2024 date, so arXiv has repackaged the source since 2016; if arXiv repackages it again the bytes may change and the CI fetch will fail loudly. The versioned and unversioned addresses gave identical bytes on 2026-11-24. First hashed reading of this paper in the Atlas: earlier readings of SPARC recorded no e-print hash. Not redistributed: the arXiv licence grants distribution rights to arXiv only.
